text.content:
The mayor who made the call.

Role: Mayor of Night City (Exec 8)
Affiliation: Formerly councilman for the Glen
Where to find them: City Hall, the Glen; guarded around the clock
Known for: Calling Tokyo in 2070 and bringing Arasaka's supercarrier into Coronado Bay

As councilman for the Glen, Rhyne called Tokyo as the NUSA 4th Army reached the city's edge in 2070. The next morning an Arasaka supercarrier sailed into Coronado Bay and the advance stopped. After the Arvin Accord made Night City a Free City, he was confirmed Mayor by acclamation within the week.

Smart, careful and very well protected, he is now the most powerful elected official in a city that rarely lets those last. He owes Arasaka, knows it, and hates it; so does every corp that didn't get a waterfront. His life expectancy is a popular bet at the Afterlife, and everybody wants to know what he promised.

GM secrets

Who gave Rhyne the number? Lyle Thompson's theory: Michiko Arasaka, who had dinner with him at 7th Hell in March 2070. Thompson has the receipt.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.16; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 05, 10
